<p class="page-lead">This bibliography combines papers linked directly to SEEM's public software with recent outputs from the public ORCID records of current group members. DOI metadata was checked against Crossref on 17 August 2026.</p>

::: {.callout-note}
## Scope

The list prioritizes peer-reviewed work from 2024–2026, adds the group's 2023 microseismic machine-learning review, and includes repository-linked proceedings, a discussion preprint, and an accepted/in-press paper. The status is stated when a record is not yet a final journal article.
:::
